d:
Yaar, kabhi lagta hai ki tumhara brain ek Chrome browser hai with too many tabs open? Doodh choose karne se lekar online endless scrolling tak, this raw and honest monologue captures what it's really like living in our overstimulated duniya.
This piece perfectly captures the mental exhaustion of modern life - jahan even simple decisions feel overwhelming lagti hain aur humara mind constantly race karta rehta hai between career anxiety, relationship thoughts, aur woh side hustle jo kabhi start hi nahi kiya.
